description: The bar chart illustrates the CoLeG-R (%) performances for three different LLaMA-2 models—LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B—under four distinct training conditions, with the horizontal axis representing the model categories and the vertical axis representing the CoLeG-R percentage on a linear scale from 0 to 80 with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. Each model category contains four vertically stacked bars, each corresponding to a different condition as defined in the legend: 'no SFT' (blue with white diagonal stripes), '+ SFT on D₀' (yellow with white horizontal stripes), '+ SFT on D₀, D₁' (purple with slanted stripes), and '+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂' (peach with solid fill). For LLaMA-2-7B, the 'no SFT' bar reaches approximately 66%, the '+ SFT on D₀' bar is also at 66%, the '+ SFT on D₀, D₁' bar is around 75%, and the '+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂' bar is close to 78%. For LLaMA-2-13B, the 'no SFT' bar is around 70%, the '+ SFT on D₀' bar is at 72%, the '+ SFT on D₀, D₁' bar is approximately 78%, and the '+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂' bar is about 76%. For LLaMA-2-70B, the 'no SFT' bar is just above 80%, the '+ SFT on D₀' bar is at 81%, the '+ SFT on D₀, D₁' bar is around 78%, and the '+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂' bar is close to 76%. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the model categories, with no visual emphasis or annotation beyond the color-coded patterns and the legend located in the bottom right corner.
caption_used: The bar chart illustrates the CoLeG-R (%) performances for different models under varying conditions. The horizontal axis contains the categories labeled as 'LLAMA-2-7B', 'LLAMA-2-13B', and 'LLAMA-2-70B'. The vertical axis represents the CoLeG-R percentage, labeled as 'CoLeG-R (%)' with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, and numerical tick marks at intervals of 10. Each category consists of four stacked bars representing different conditions: 'no SFT' in blue with white diagonal stripes, '+ SFT on D₀' in yellow with white horizontal stripes patterns, '+ SFT on D₀, D₁' in purple with slanted stripes, and '+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂' in peach with solid fill. For LLAMA-2-7B, the blue bar reaches approximately 66%, yellow at 66%, purple at around 75%, and red close to 78%. For LLAMA-2-13B, the blue bar is around 70%, yellow at 72%, purple at approximately 78%, and red about 76%. For LLAMA-2-70B, the blue bar is just above 80%, yellow at 81%, purple around 78%, and red reaching close to 76%. The results suggest that scaling up the SFT dataset leads to diminishing returns for larger models, as the performance of LLAMA-2-70B stabilizes across conditions. A legend is given bottom right.
